title: The Taste of You
subtitle: An International Romance
author: Walusimbi Leon (SGSS)
description: An explicit international romance of food and desire between a chef and a lover across Paris, Beirut, Brooklyn, and the Amalfi Coast — 20 chapters of hunger, intimacy, and love.
style: Sensual, immersive third-person prose. Rich culinary and sensory detail. Explicit but literary; emotionally honest.
characters: Lena Voss and Kofi Asante — lovers separated and reunited across continents.
setting: Paris, Beirut, Brooklyn, Amalfi Coast, Santorini.
notes: The main story is complete (20 chapters). Write an extended-edition epilogue chapter after the ending: their life together, the restaurant, the family — keeping the signature sensory, culinary intimacy.
